name: thinwindow
description: Less in the window. Less on the bill. ThinWindow makes Claude use less context — without changing the outcome. A plugin and Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cowork, and the Claude apps, benchmarked in Claude Code on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 4.5: 7–11% lower cost, 3–6% fewer tokens.
